proof_body:
by
  intro x₁ y₁ x₂ y₂ x₃ y₃ hD
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ : ∃ u, u = x₂ - x₁ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ : ∃ v, v = y₂ - y₁ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ : ∃ s, s = x₃ - x₁ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ : ∃ t, t = y₃ - y₁ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have ex₂ : x₂ = x₁ + u := by linarith
  have ey₂ : y₂ = y₁ + v := by linarith
  have ex₃ : x₃ = x₁ + s := by linarith
  have ey₃ : y₃ = y₁ + t := by linarith
  subst ex₂ ey₂ ex₃ ey₃
  have hD' : u * t - v * s ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; apply hD; rw [hu, hv, hs, ht] at h; linarith
  clear hu hv hs ht hD
  have hcx : ∃ X Y : ℝ, 2 * (u * X + v * Y) = u ^ 2 + v ^ 2 ∧ 2 * (s * X + t * Y) = s ^ 2 + t ^ 2 := by
    refine ⟨(t * (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) - v * (s ^ 2 + t ^ 2)) / (2 * (u * t - v * s)), (u * (s ^ 2 + t ^ 2) - s * (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2)) / (2 * (u * t - v * s)), ?_, ?_⟩
    · have e : 2 * (u * ((t * (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) - v * (s ^ 2 + t ^ 2)) / (2 * (u * t - v * s))) + v * ((u * (s ^ 2 + t ^ 2) - s * (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2)) / (2 * (u * t - v * s)))) = (u * (t * (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) - v * (s ^ 2 + t ^ 2)) + v * (u * (s ^ 2 + t ^ 2) - s * (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2))) / (u * t - v * s) := by
        field_simp
      rw [e, div_eq_iff hD']; ring
    · have e : 2 * (s * ((t * (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) - v * (s ^ 2 + t ^ 2)) / (2 * (u * t - v * s))) + t * ((u * (s ^ 2 + t ^ 2) - s * (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2)) / (2 * (u * t - v * s)))) = (s * (t * (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) - v * (s ^ 2 + t ^ 2)) + t * (u * (s ^ 2 + t ^ 2) - s * (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2))) / (u * t - v * s) := by
        field_simp
      rw [e, div_eq_iff hD']; ring
  obtain ⟨X, Y, hX, hY⟩ := hcx
  have hpos : 0 < X ^ 2 + Y ^ 2 := by
    by_contra hc
    have hsq : X ^ 2 + Y ^ 2 = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hc) (by positivity)
    obtain ⟨hX2, hY2⟩ := (add_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _)).mp hsq
    have hX0 : X = 0 := pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero |>.mp hX2
    have hY0 : Y = 0 := pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero |>.mp hY2
    rw [hX0, hY0] at hX
    have huv : u ^ 2 + v ^ 2 = 0 := by linear_combination -hX
    obtain ⟨hu2, hv2⟩ := (add_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _)).mp huv
    have h1 : u = 0 := pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero |>.mp hu2
    have h2 : v = 0 := pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero |>.mp hv2
    apply hD'; rw [h1, h2]; ring
  refine ⟨(x₁ + X, y₁ + Y, Real.sqrt (X ^ 2 + Y ^ 2)), ⟨Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hpos, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · simp only [Real.sq_sqrt hpos.le]; ring
  · simp only [Real.sq_sqrt hpos.le]; linear_combination -hX
  · simp only [Real.sq_sqrt hpos.le]; linear_combination -hY
  · rintro ⟨c₁, c₂, ρ⟩ ⟨hρ, h₁, h₂, h₃⟩
    simp only at hρ h₁ h₂ h₃
    have e₁ : 2 * (u * (c₁ - x₁) + v * (c₂ - y₁)) = u ^ 2 + v ^ 2 := by linear_combination h₁ - h₂
    have e₂ : 2 * (s * (c₁ - x₁) + t * (c₂ - y₁)) = s ^ 2 + t ^ 2 := by linear_combination h₁ - h₃
    have d₁ : (u * t - v * s) * (c₁ - x₁ - X) = 0 := by
      linear_combination (t / 2) * (e₁ - hX) - (v / 2) * (e₂ - hY)
    have d₂ : (u * t - v * s) * (c₂ - y₁ - Y) = 0 := by
      linear_combination (u / 2) * (e₂ - hY) - (s / 2) * (e₁ - hX)
    have c1 : c₁ = x₁ + X := by
      have := (mul_eq_zero.mp d₁).resolve_left hD'
      linarith
    have c2 : c₂ = y₁ + Y := by
      have := (mul_eq_zero.mp d₂).resolve_left hD'
      linarith
    subst c1 c2
    have hρ2 : ρ ^ 2 = X ^ 2 + Y ^ 2 := by linear_combination -h₁
    have : ρ = Real.sqrt (X ^ 2 + Y ^ 2) := by
      rw [← hρ2, Real.sqrt_sq hρ.le]
    rw [this]
